note: Three items used in idol-making are mentioned: file (_lima_, Feile), burning coals (_prunae_, plural), and hammer (_malleus_, also plural). Why _lima_ should be mentioned first, remains unclear, but it is not possible to give the word a different meaning such as “pair of tongs.”
_norma_ – try measure, a builder’s tool; see glossary s.v. _norma_ (Chapter 19.2).
